title: AL Development Update | October 2026
headline: Aave Labs' October update reports Aave V4 deposits above $1.5B, the first external curator on V4, and an ARFC to establish the Aave Foundation.
summary: Aave Labs' monthly update, written under its service provider scope, reports the following for October 2026. Aave reached $1.1T in all-time borrow volume. Aave V4 deposits passed $1.5B, a new all-time high, with active loans above $450M; on Base, the tokenized-stock loan market crossed $9M in deposits and approached $4M in loans. Aave Labs led the integration of Sentora, the first external curator on V4, which would operate a dedicated Hub and Spokes on Ethereum. It onboarded syrupUSDC on Arc and USDe on Avalanche to V4, and supported the Babylon integration for native BTC collateral. It published the Aave V3.8 ARFC and implemented an oracle deprecation, a Liquidation Protocol Fee increase and an ETH and BTC collateral efficiency revision. It also published the ARFC to establish the Aave Foundation, a memberless entity to hold the Aave trademark and related IP; Phase 1 covers incorporation and appointing an initial independent director and supervisor, with later phases returning to governance. Integrations listed include Circle Mint USDC borrowing against cirBTC, Privy Earn, and the Aave MCP server connecting to the MetaMask Agent Wallet.
